ae4410186c6b051f8fc5e416ccc37c3ea5d8ade8.body:
The charts' viewBox is 1000 wide, drawn at 680 px on a phone, so 11 px
ticks and values showed at about 7.5 px; my own check skipped SVG text
(offsetParent is null for SVG). Each svg.wxc-chart and svg.wxc-map now
gets --ck = viewBox width / drawn width (at least 1), set on render and
by a ResizeObserver (fold opened, rotation); their font sizes are
calc(Npx * var(--ck, 1)). Measured at drawn size with all folds open:
390 84 -> 0, 1280 0 -> 0, light and dark; no page error, no overflow.
